title: Senior Developer ( .Net Core & angular)
description:
**Job Description**
**ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES :**
Looking for an ASP.NET Core Developer to be responsible for product design, development, and support. The responsibilities of ASP.NET Core Developers include writing code, designing solutions for applications, and
  
  
improving functionality for a product.
  
  
To be successful as an ASP.NET Core Developer, you should demonstrate excellent problem-solving skills, high-quality coding skills, and an ability to manage your time efficiently. Developer should have superior knowledge of software development, a keen eye for detail, and be able to work independently.
  
  
**Senior Developer Responsibilities**

* Creating top-quality product development.
* Collaborating with front-end developers.
* Ensuring that junior developers deliver according to coding standards and best practices.
* Learn latest language and technology. Apply learning skills on the product development.
* Using the most updated and appropriate technologies.
* Designing and building application layers.
* Think of best solutions for development and research for the product.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS :**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or similar.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in ASP.NET development.
* Experience in developing applications using JavaScript framework like ReactJS or Angular
* Front end development using Bootstrap, font awesome or Material framework
* Extensive working knowledge of coding using .NET languages (C# & .NET).
* Familiarity with ASP.NET framework and SQL servers.
* Working experience in Azure functions / Micro services architecture
* Strong communication skills.

**PREFERRED SKILLS :**

* Working knowledge in SharePoint, Azure Cloud

Skill Required
